why: Muse is the provider where an unrecognised working screen is not merely
     unknown. Upstream's `idle_prompt` (700) and `idle_status_fallback` (500)
     are both `visible_idle`, and both match this screen — the composer is
     drawn and the footer is there — so without a working rule a thinking pane
     reads as an explicit visible idle and the tracker announces a completed
     turn. Upstream reads Muse activity through the "esc to interrupt" hint,
     which this shape does not carry. See manifests/sidecar/muse.toml
     (`sidecar.thinking_working`).
